evals.prompt: CBRD-27310 tc 만들어서 PR까지 올려줘. GROUP_CONCAT을 ORDER BY와 같이 쓰면 결과 문자열이 중간에 잘리던 버그고 guava에서 픽스됐어.
evals.expected_output: This is a targeted call (a human enumerated CBRD-27310), so its completion is a real write: a ready-for-review PR, not a draft. Process a single issue end-to-end through Select→Ground→(Author→Verify→Review loop, at least 2 rounds)→Submit. Produces a verified .sql plus the .answer generated by Verify on the tc/cbrd-27310 branch, an upstream ready-for-review PR (<your-fork>:tc/cbrd-27310 → CUBRID/cubrid-testcases:develop, where <your-fork> is the runner's own fork derived from gh identity, not a hardcoded person) that a human still approves and merges, and a report at $HOME/.cubrid-agent/reports/author-testcase/CBRD-27310.md. The skill does not fire the Start Test transition (that is gate-resolved's; Jira left untouched by this skill).

assertions.name: runs_full_pipeline_stages
assertions.description: The output/report shows evidence that the stages ran in order — Select, Ground, then a static loop of Author/lint/Review R1, then Verify once, then Review R2 on the generated answer, then Submit — with the CTP chain entered only after the static review passed

assertions.name: delegates_author_and_verify
assertions.description: Authoring is delegated to create-sql, local execution/answer generation to verify-sql, and review to a separate subagent; the orchestrator does not write any of it inline itself

assertions.name: ready_for_review_pr
assertions.description: The PR is opened ready for review (not --draft) because the call is targeted, head=<your-fork>:tc/cbrd-27310 (the runner's own fork, derived from gh identity — not a hardcoded person), base=CUBRID/cubrid-testcases:develop, and is neither merged nor approved (a human still approves/merges)

assertions.name: does_not_fire_start_test
assertions.description: It performs no Jira state transitions or writes; the Start Test transition is gate-resolved's, so author-testcase does not fire it

assertions.name: answer_generated_not_handwritten
assertions.description: The .answer is generated via Verify's empty-answer trick, not handwritten

assertions.name: report_at_canonical_path
assertions.description: $HOME/.cubrid-agent/reports/author-testcase/CBRD-27310.md records the Select rationale, the per-round loop history, and the final PR link

evals.prompt: 다음 Resolved 이슈 하나 골라서 sql tc 작성해줘. 지금 이 머신엔 픽스 포함된 신뢰 빌드가 안 깔려 있어.
evals.expected_output: Select one oldest-resolved issue from the JQL queue, Ground it using its attachments and the fix commit, then Author a .sql on the tc/cbrd-XXXXX branch and COMMIT it there before leaving the Author stage, so the work survives even though the run stops early. Since there is no build containing the fix and no CTP environment, leave the .answer empty and hand it off together with verify-sql handoff instructions (no fabricated verification, no Draft PR created). Record the handoff reason in the report, and only claim the branch holds the TC after confirming the commit with git log.

assertions.name: selects_oldest_resolved_first
assertions.description: Picks the next single issue from the queue in oldest-resolved order using the JQL (guava · Resolved · QA Assignee = the runner's own Jira user, taken from the exported CUBRID_JIRA_USER — published by setup-cubrid-agent's env.sh — and never parsed out of ~/.netrc by the skill itself, nor hardcoded to a person); an empty or hostname-like value makes the skill STOP and ask for it instead of reporting an empty queue

assertions.name: grounds_before_authoring
assertions.description: Before Author, the Ground step downloads and reads every attachment and investigates the fix commit/PR to build the case list

assertions.name: empty_answer_no_fake_verify
assertions.description: Leaves the .answer empty and does not invent verification results

assertions.name: tc_committed_on_branch_despite_early_stop
assertions.description: The authored .sql/.answer pair is committed on the tc/cbrd-XXXXX branch during the Author stage, so stopping before Verify does not leave the work as untracked files; the report claims the branch holds it only after verifying with git log

assertions.name: no_pr_without_verify
assertions.description: Since the verify gate was not passed, it does not create a Draft PR and instead hands off with verify-sql handoff instructions

assertions.name: report_records_handoff
assertions.description: The report records the handoff reason (the absence of a build) instead of a PR link

evals.prompt: CBRD-27055 sql tc 파이프라인 돌려줘. 동시 트랜잭션에서 간헐적으로 유니크 위반이 안 잡히던 race 버그였고 guava에서 픽스됐어.
evals.expected_output: This is a targeted call (a human enumerated CBRD-27055), so a successful completion is a ready-for-review PR, not a draft. Run the pipeline. As a determinism gate, Verify runs the case N=3 times within a single CTP session and also performs CCI cross-checking. If the case cannot be made deterministic, or if it fails to pass all three gates within 5 rounds, keep the tc/cbrd-27055 branch locally, record the skip reason plus diagnosis in the report, and do not open a PR. Once stabilized, open a ready-for-review PR that a human still approves/merges, whose Remarks carry the fail→pass and determinism evidence. The skill does not fire the Start Test transition.

assertions.name: determinism_gate_n3_single_session
assertions.description: Verify runs the case 3 times within a single CTP interactive session as a determinism signal (it does not spin up 3 separate sessions)

assertions.name: cci_cross_check_recorded
assertions.description: Records verify.cci.checked and promotes .answer_cci only when the CCI output differs from JDBC

assertions.name: separate_review_lane
assertions.description: Review runs in a fresh-context subagent distinct from the author, so it does not self-approve

assertions.name: skip_reason_on_loop_exhaustion
assertions.description: If not all gates pass within 5 rounds, it preserves the branch locally without a PR and leaves the skip reason plus diagnosis in the report

assertions.name: pr_remarks_have_failpass_evidence
assertions.description: If submitted, the PR Remarks contain the build id, loop count, determinism N, and fail→pass result
